local: The key will be handed to the Modlight app that shows the code {code}, wherever that app runs: it collects the key from this server with a one-time secret that only it knows.

confirm.label: Confirmation code
confirm.match: Approve only if this code matches the one in your Modlight app.
confirm.mismatch: If no Modlight app of yours shows this code, or it shows a different one, choose Not now: someone else may be waiting for this key.

waiting.title: {client} is picking up its key
waiting.body: The app collects the key from {appName} by itself. Keep it open; this usually takes a few seconds.
waiting.close: You can close this window once the app says it is signed in.

fallback.summary: App still not signed in after a minute?
fallback.body: Copy this key and paste it into the app's sign-in window instead.
